The Feathers Fly Part II#000.dst: Reúnete con Ava cerca de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#001.src: Oh... So you showed up! I'm glad, I really am!
The Feathers Fly Part II#001.dst: ¡Oh... así que has venido! ¡Me alegro, de verdad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#001.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#002.src: It's time for me to show the Growth Accelerator to the Corkians.
The Feathers Fly Part II#002.dst: Ya toca enseñarles el Acelerador de Crecimiento a los corkianos.
The Feathers Fly Part II#002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#003.src: Look, this time I'll really try and reward you well, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#003.dst: Mira, esta vez intentaré recompensarte bien de verdad, ¿vale?
The Feathers Fly Part II#003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#004.src: Anyway! I have a plan. You see, I definitely can't easily get in the city.
The Feathers Fly Part II#004.dst: ¡En fin! Tengo un plan. Verás, yo no puedo entrar en la ciudad así como así.
The Feathers Fly Part II#004.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#005.src: The Corkians have a council where they deal with their issues. We can try getting an audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#005.dst: Los corkianos tienen un Consejo que se ocupa de sus asuntos. Podemos intentar conseguir una audiencia.
The Feathers Fly Part II#005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#006.src: I know a way for me to get in the city. That's where you come in! There are some sentries to take care of.
The Feathers Fly Part II#006.dst: Sé cómo colarme en la ciudad. ¡Ahí entras tú! Hay unos centinelas de los que hay que ocuparse.
The Feathers Fly Part II#006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#007.src: They're really old models though, somehow. I'll give you a jammer I made for this. Right-Click a robot to use it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#007.dst: Aunque, no sé por qué, son modelos muy viejos. Te daré un inhibidor que hice. ¡Clic derecho en un robot!
The Feathers Fly Part II#007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#008.src: Once you jam one robot, you'll have to jam all others within {~} seconds! So try to plan ahead and locate them all before jamming one!
The Feathers Fly Part II#008.dst: En cuanto inhibas a un robot, ¡tendrás {~} segundos para inhibir a todos los demás! ¡Así que localízalos todos antes de empezar!
The Feathers Fly Part II#008.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#009.src: Tell me once you're ready. I'll throw you in there. I'll join you afterwards. You'll see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#009.dst: Avísame cuando estés listo. Te lanzaré ahí dentro y luego te alcanzo. ¡Ya verás!
The Feathers Fly Part II#009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#010.src: Well then, first off, take this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#011.src: Now, just stand still... I gotta try something on you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#011.dst: Ahora quédate quieto... voy a probar algo contigo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#011.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#012.src: Locate and jam all the robot sentries near the Corkus Clocktower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] within {~} seconds
The Feathers Fly Part II#012.dst: Localiza e inhibe a todos los centinelas robot cerca de la torre del reloj de Corkus en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] en menos de {~} segundos

The Feathers Fly Part II#014.src: Thanks! These robots were harmless but hey, better safe than sorry right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#014.dst: ¡Gracias! Esos robots eran inofensivos, pero más vale prevenir, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#014.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#015.src: Anyway, we need to get ready to meet the Corkian Council.
The Feathers Fly Part II#015.dst: En fin, tenemos que prepararnos para ver al Consejo corkiano.
The Feathers Fly Part II#015.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#016.src: And I think... I need a disguise. I don't like hiding myself, but I don't have a choice.
The Feathers Fly Part II#016.dst: Y creo que... necesito un disfraz. No me gusta esconderme, pero no me queda otra.
The Feathers Fly Part II#016.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#017.src: Thanks to some plans I got, I know where to find some. Follow me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#017.dst: Gracias a unos planos que conseguí, sé dónde encontrarlos. ¡Sígueme!
The Feathers Fly Part II#017.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#018.src: Here we are! I'm pretty sure we can find some outfits in there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#018.dst: ¡Ya estamos! Seguro que ahí dentro encontramos ropa.
The Feathers Fly Part II#018.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#019.src: I'll stand here to quickly hide in case anyone comes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#019.dst: Yo me quedo aquí para esconderme rápido si viene alguien.
The Feathers Fly Part II#019.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#020.src: Just look around, and come back with what you think looks better!
The Feathers Fly Part II#020.dst: ¡Echa un vistazo y vuelve con lo que mejor te parezca!
The Feathers Fly Part II#020.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#021.src: Yeah, I am letting you choose my outfit. Aren't you lucky? Go and get me the fanciest clothes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#021.dst: Sí, te dejo elegir mi ropa. ¿A que tienes suerte? ¡Ve a buscarme la ropa más elegante!
The Feathers Fly Part II#021.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#022.src: Pick an outfit to fit in with the Corkians and bring it to Ava at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#022.dst: Elige un atuendo para pasar desapercibido entre los corkianos y llévaselo a Ava en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#023.src: I'm trusting you. We Avos aren't exactly into... Fashion. Then again, they're not into Electromagic either, so what do I know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#023.dst: Confío en ti. A los Avos no se nos da muy bien... la moda. Aunque bueno, a ellos tampoco la electromagia, así que qué sabré yo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#023.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#026.src: I feel like... I'm about to go to work.
The Feathers Fly Part II#026.dst: Siento que... voy a ir a trabajar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#026.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#027.src: At the very least, I'll probably blend in very well!
The Feathers Fly Part II#027.dst: ¡Por lo menos seguro que paso desapercibida!
The Feathers Fly Part II#027.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#028.src: Now, I'm gonna be completely honest about this, so don't panic, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#028.dst: Voy a ser del todo sincera, así que no te asustes, pero...
The Feathers Fly Part II#028.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#029.src: I have... absolutely NO idea how we could even get an audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#029.dst: No tengo... NI IDEA de cómo conseguir una audiencia.
The Feathers Fly Part II#029.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#030.src: I think we need to split up and try to find out how to get one from the Council.
The Feathers Fly Part II#030.dst: Creo que deberíamos separarnos y averiguar cómo conseguir una del Consejo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#030.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#031.src: I'll be around the town center if ya need me for anything! I'll ask around. You should too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#031.dst: ¡Estaré por el centro del pueblo si me necesitas! Voy a preguntar por ahí. ¡Tú también!
The Feathers Fly Part II#031.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#032.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if that's a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#032.dst: Una última cosa... Perdona si es un poco raro, pero...
The Feathers Fly Part II#032.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#034.src: {u}, huh? That's... A nice name. Well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#034.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#037.src: I've already seen plenty of green in my lifetime, y'know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#037.dst: Ya he visto bastante verde en mi vida, ¿sabes?
The Feathers Fly Part II#037.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#038.src: Well, I know you folks sure do love money. Maybe we can get noticed with this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#038.dst: Bueno, sé que a los vuestros les encanta el dinero. Quizá así llamemos la atención...
The Feathers Fly Part II#038.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#039.src: Hmm... You know, this could actually work!
The Feathers Fly Part II#039.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#040.src: I have no idea how this audience things works but i could try to get people to notice me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#040.dst: No tengo ni idea de cómo va esto de las audiencias, ¡pero puedo intentar llamar la atención!
The Feathers Fly Part II#040.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#041.src: Well, we should split up and meet up later to see what information we have. Just ask around town!
The Feathers Fly Part II#041.dst: Bueno, separémonos y vemos luego qué información tenemos. ¡Tú pregunta por el pueblo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#041.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#042.src: I'll be around the town center if you got any information!
The Feathers Fly Part II#042.dst: ¡Estaré por el centro del pueblo si consigues información!
The Feathers Fly Part II#042.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#043.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if thats a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#043.dst: Una última cosa... Perdona si es un poco raro, pero...
The Feathers Fly Part II#043.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#045.src: {u}, huh? That's... A nice name. Well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#045.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#048.src: Ya got good taste! I always wanted to explore the ocean, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#048.dst: ¡Tienes buen gusto! Siempre quise explorar el océano, ¿sabes?
The Feathers Fly Part II#048.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#049.src: Hey, thanks for helping me out so much. You've been such a huge help!
The Feathers Fly Part II#049.dst: Oye, gracias por ayudarme tanto. ¡Has sido de gran ayuda!
The Feathers Fly Part II#049.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#050.src: Well, this isn't over, of course. And to tell you the truth...
The Feathers Fly Part II#050.dst: Bueno, esto no ha acabado, claro. Y a decir verdad...
The Feathers Fly Part II#050.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#051.src: I, uh, have no idea how to get an audience... Sorry?
The Feathers Fly Part II#051.dst: No tengo, eh, ni idea de cómo conseguir una audiencia... ¿Perdón?
The Feathers Fly Part II#051.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#052.src: I think we need to split up and try to find out how to get one.
The Feathers Fly Part II#052.dst: Creo que deberíamos separarnos y averiguar cómo conseguir una.
The Feathers Fly Part II#052.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#053.src: I'll be around the town center if ya need me for anything!
The Feathers Fly Part II#053.dst: ¡Estaré por el centro del pueblo si me necesitas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#053.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#054.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if that's a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#054.dst: Una última cosa... Perdona si es un poco raro, pero...
The Feathers Fly Part II#054.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#056.src: {u}, huh? That's... A nice name. Well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#056.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#057.src: Oh, and check this mask out! Time to be Ava the human!
The Feathers Fly Part II#057.dst: ¡Ah, y mira esta máscara! ¡Ava se vuelve humana!
The Feathers Fly Part II#057.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#059.src: I feel like... I'm not even supposed to be wearing this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#059.dst: Siento que... ni siquiera debería llevar esto.
The Feathers Fly Part II#059.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#060.src: This looks... Really, really cool though! ...Wait, where did you even find this?
The Feathers Fly Part II#060.dst: ¡Aunque queda... muy, muy chulo! ...Espera, ¿de dónde has sacado esto?
The Feathers Fly Part II#060.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#061.src: I saw this dog, and... Well, that's besides the point. You'll tell me later!
The Feathers Fly Part II#061.dst: Vi un perro y... bueno, eso da igual. ¡Ya me lo contarás!
The Feathers Fly Part II#061.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#062.src: Look, this audience thing is foreign to me but I feel like it won't really be an issue with this... thing.
The Feathers Fly Part II#062.dst: Mira, lo de la audiencia me suena a chino, pero creo que con esta... cosa no habrá problema.
The Feathers Fly Part II#062.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#063.src: Well, we still need information on who to even talk to for that stuff... I'll ask around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#063.dst: Aun así, nos falta saber con quién hay que hablar para eso... Voy a preguntar por ahí.
The Feathers Fly Part II#063.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#064.src: You should too! I'll be around the town center! Come by once you got enough information!
The Feathers Fly Part II#064.dst: ¡Tú también! ¡Estaré por el centro del pueblo! ¡Pásate cuando tengas suficiente información!
The Feathers Fly Part II#064.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#065.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if that's a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#065.dst: Una última cosa... Perdona si es un poco raro, pero...
The Feathers Fly Part II#065.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#067.src: {u}, huh? That's... A nice name. Well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#067.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#068.src: Ask around {p} for a way to get an audience with the Council. Ava is at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#068.dst: Pregunta por {p} cómo conseguir una audiencia con el Consejo. Ava está en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#070.src: Alright, so it's not really on the legal side of things, BUT apparently...
The Feathers Fly Part II#070.dst: Vale, no es que sea muy legal, PERO por lo visto...
The Feathers Fly Part II#070.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#071.src: There's some sort of... Shady dealer you can buy an audience invitation from?
The Feathers Fly Part II#071.dst: Hay una especie de... traficante turbio que te vende una invitación, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#071.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#072.src: I'm sure there are other ways, but the dude should be in the castle to the east, first door to the left.
The Feathers Fly Part II#072.dst: Seguro que hay otras formas, pero el tipo debería estar en el castillo del este, primera puerta a la izquierda.
The Feathers Fly Part II#072.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#073.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#073.dst: Haz lo que quieras con eso. Yo supongo que... seguiré buscando.
The Feathers Fly Part II#073.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#074.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#074.dst: ¿Una audiencia? Ah, eres de esos, ya veo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#074.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#075.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#075.dst: Sí, sí, cruza ese castillo de ahí y llegarás a la recepcionista.
The Feathers Fly Part II#075.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#076.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#076.dst: Las posibilidades de conseguirla son mínimas. Tendrías más suerte robándole la invitación a alguien, ¡je!
The Feathers Fly Part II#076.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#077.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#077.dst: Y hablando de eso... creo que justo pasó hace una hora al otro lado del pueblo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#077.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#078.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#078.dst: A lo mejor puedes ayudar a quien perdió su invitación. O robarla. ¡Yo no soy tu jefe! ¡Y ahora, largo! ¡No pises mis plantas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#078.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#080.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#080.dst: O sea, sí, cualquiera puede intentarlo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#080.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#081.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#081.dst: Pero hay que ser impresionante de verdad. No quiero ser borde, pero no vas a dar la talla.
The Feathers Fly Part II#081.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#082.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#082.dst: Si de verdad quieres, la recepcionista está en el castillo. Ve al este y no pares.
The Feathers Fly Part II#082.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#083.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#083.dst: Eso sí, te aviso: con la de locos que entran, nunca está de buen humor.
The Feathers Fly Part II#083.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#084.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#084.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#085.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#085.dst: Uf... Déjame adivinar qué es tu máquina. ¿Un arma? ¿Qué dispara? ¿Arena?
The Feathers Fly Part II#085.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#086.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#086.dst: Perdona, es que cansa un poco. Si de verdad quieres una audiencia, hay una recepcionista para eso.
The Feathers Fly Part II#086.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#087.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#087.dst: Pregunta a otros. Yo no llevo ese tipo de cosas.
The Feathers Fly Part II#087.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#088.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#088.dst: ¡¿Ah, tú también quieres conseguir una audiencia?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#088.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#089.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#089.dst: ¡Llevo forjando las mejores espadas robotizadas que verá el mundo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#089.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#090.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#090.dst: ¡Mira, tienes que ir a ver a la recepcionista y dejarla flipando!
The Feathers Fly Part II#090.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#091.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#091.dst: ¡Es genial! En el peor caso mueres, ¡pero con suerte solo te rompes un brazo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#091.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#092.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#092.dst: ¡Está dentro del castillo del este! Cruza y sigue andando, ¡al final llegas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#092.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#093.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#093.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#094.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#094.dst: Mmm... Así que podemos ir a ver a una recepcionista y quizá nos conceda una audiencia. ¡Entendido!
The Feathers Fly Part II#094.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#095.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#095.dst: Entramos, le enseñamos lo molones que somos y con eso bastará, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#095.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#096.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#096.dst: No pasa nada, seguro que solo hay que demostrarle tu determinación o algo así.
The Feathers Fly Part II#096.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#097.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#097.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#098.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#098.dst: ¡Por lo visto hay un tipo turbio que vende invitaciones a audiencias!
The Feathers Fly Part II#098.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#099.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#099.dst: Creo que está en el castillo del este, ¿primera a la izquierda? Aunque...
The Feathers Fly Part II#099.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#100.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#100.dst: Seguro que hay otras formas de lograrlo. ¡La recepcionista, por ejemplo! Está en la última sala del castillo, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#100.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#101.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#101.dst: De hecho, ¡si quieres que te acompañe, puedo! ¡Solo dímelo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#101.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#103.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#103.dst: Eh, chaval. Una audiencia, ¿eh? Je je je... Se me ocurre algo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#103.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#104.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#104.dst: ¿Sabes? Es difícil conseguir una... Muuuuy difícil... Pero sé cómo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#104.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#105.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#105.dst: Es muy, muy sencillo... ¡Solo tienes que darme [{~} bloques de esmeralda] y yo me encargo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#105.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#106.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#106.dst: ...je je je... ¡Bueno, ya sabes dónde encontrarme si te animas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#106.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#107.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#107.dst: ¿Así que has encontrado a ese vendedor raro? No estarás pensando en...
The Feathers Fly Part II#107.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#108.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#108.dst: O sea... la verdad es que sí sería una forma de conseguir una audiencia. ¿Qué quiere?
The Feathers Fly Part II#108.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#109.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#109.dst: ¿[{~} bloques de esmeralda]? ¿Es mucho? ¡No soy humana! ¡En fin!
The Feathers Fly Part II#109.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#110.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#110.dst: Cómpralo si quieres, pero estoy segura de que hay otras formas de conseguir una audiencia. No hace falta que lo compres.
The Feathers Fly Part II#110.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#111.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#111.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#112.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#112.dst: ¡Muchas gracias! Un placer hacer negocios contigo, je je... ¡Suerte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#112.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#114.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#114.dst: ¡¿Pero qué os pasa a todos?! ¡¿No puedo estar tranquila CINCO MINUTOS?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#114.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#115.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#115.dst: Ay, perdoooona, ¿te ha dicho alguien que vengas? ¿Vas a «impresionarme»?
The Feathers Fly Part II#115.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#116.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#116.dst: Pues te lo digo ya: has FALLADO.
The Feathers Fly Part II#116.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#117.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#117.dst: Vuelve cuando tengas algo de interés de verdad. Adiós.
The Feathers Fly Part II#117.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#118.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#118.dst: ¿Ah? ¿Has encontrado al vendedor y otra forma de conseguir audiencia?
The Feathers Fly Part II#118.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#119.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#119.dst: ¿[{~} bloques de esmeralda], eh? Ni idea de si es mucho. ¡Yo digo que probemos tu otra opción! ¿Cuál es?
The Feathers Fly Part II#119.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#120.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#120.dst: ¿Hay una recepcionista para las audiencias? ¡Qué cómodo! ¡Pues vamos a hablar con ella!
The Feathers Fly Part II#120.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#121.src: It's... Apparently really hard? Oh... Well, that's not helpful. Maybe we can still give it a go?
The Feathers Fly Part II#121.dst: Y... ¿parece que es muy difícil? Oh... Pues eso no ayuda. ¿Podemos intentarlo igualmente?
The Feathers Fly Part II#121.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#122.src: Buy from that weird dealer if ya want, but we also should try to go see that receptionist. Tell me if you want me to follow you there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#122.dst: Cómprale a ese vendedor raro si quieres, pero también deberíamos ir a ver a la recepcionista. Dime si quieres que te acompañe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#122.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#123.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#123.dst: Vale, pues vamos. Yo diría que evitemos al vendedor, ¡no quiero problemas con la ley!
The Feathers Fly Part II#123.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#124.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#124.dst: Así que el vendedor está ahí dentro, ¿eh? Sigamos adelante. Y evitemos ese sitio.
The Feathers Fly Part II#124.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#125.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#125.dst: Espera espera espera qué acabo de dec- Me haré pequeñita...
The Feathers Fly Part II#125.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#126.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#126.dst: ¡Eh, son [{~} bloques de esmeralda] o nada! ¡Tranquilo, os consigo audiencia a los dos! ¡Tu chica es tímida, ya veo! ¡Créeme, te entiendo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#126.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#127.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#127.dst: ¡Muchas gracias! Un placer hacer negocios contigo, je je... ¡Suerte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#127.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#130.src: And just WHO are you two, busting here like that?
The Feathers Fly Part II#130.dst: ¿Y QUIÉNES sois vosotros dos para entrar así?
The Feathers Fly Part II#130.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#131.src: Uh... Greetings... We've heard that we should come here for-
The Feathers Fly Part II#131.dst: Eh... Buenos días... Nos han dicho que viniéramos aquí para-
The Feathers Fly Part II#131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#132.src: Do you have ANYTHING to show? Shouldn't you be working at that time?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#132.dst: ¿Tenéis ALGO que enseñar? ¡¿No deberíais estar trabajando?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#132.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#133.src: No, it's just that I, well... Nevermind, I do have a thing to show, it's, uh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#133.dst: No, es solo que yo, bueno... Da igual, sí tengo algo que enseñar, es, eh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#133.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#134.src: Not ANOTHER word! I've heard enough! You two clearly don't have anything worth my time!
The Feathers Fly Part II#134.dst: ¡Ni UNA palabra más! ¡Ya he oído bastante! ¡Está claro que no tenéis nada que merezca mi tiempo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#134.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#135.src: Go back to your minimum wage job or something, but stay OUT of my room.
The Feathers Fly Part II#135.dst: Volved a vuestro trabajo de mala muerte, pero FUERA de mi sala.
The Feathers Fly Part II#135.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#136.src: The citizens said it was hard, huh? No kidding. Maybe we should've had something before strolling in.
The Feathers Fly Part II#136.dst: Los vecinos decían que era difícil, ¿eh? Y tanto. Quizá deberíamos haber traído algo antes de entrar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#137.src: Look, we'll figure out another approach. This can't end here! We need an audience invitation letter.
The Feathers Fly Part II#137.dst: Mira, ya buscaremos otra forma. ¡Esto no acaba aquí! Necesitamos una carta de invitación a la audiencia.
The Feathers Fly Part II#137.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#138.src: I'll head back to the town center, so if you want to talk I'll see ya there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#138.dst: Yo vuelvo al centro del pueblo, ¡si quieres hablar nos vemos allí!
The Feathers Fly Part II#138.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#139.src: That certainly didn't go well. But keep your head up! We got this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#139.dst: Desde luego no ha ido bien. ¡Pero ánimo! ¡Podemos con esto!
The Feathers Fly Part II#139.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#140.src: There was a normal way to get an audience which is via a competition. We... missed it. So that'll have to pass.
The Feathers Fly Part II#140.dst: Había una forma normal de conseguir audiencia: un concurso. Nos lo... perdimos. Así que habrá que olvidarlo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#141.src: Now, for other... Unconventional ways... There was some panic by the Armour Merchant earlier today.
The Feathers Fly Part II#141.dst: Y en cuanto a otras formas... poco convencionales... Hoy ha habido jaleo junto al mercader de armaduras.
The Feathers Fly Part II#141.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#142.src: Check it out if you want, I won't cause trouble. I'd rather be the friendly neighbourhood mechanic!
The Feathers Fly Part II#142.dst: Échale un ojo si quieres, yo no voy a causar problemas. ¡Prefiero ser la mecánica simpática del barrio!
The Feathers Fly Part II#142.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#143.src: There is apparently a dealer in the castle the receptionist's in, first entrance to the left. However, he charges emeralds...
The Feathers Fly Part II#143.dst: Por lo visto hay un vendedor en el castillo de la recepcionista, primera entrada a la izquierda. Pero cobra esmeraldas...
The Feathers Fly Part II#143.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#144.src: I'm sure we can find a free alternative. I'm counting on ya! Just tell me if you want me to follow you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#144.dst: Seguro que encontramos una alternativa gratis. ¡Cuento contigo! ¡Dime si quieres que te acompañe!
The Feathers Fly Part II#144.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#145.src: Let's hope we get this right. You lead, I follow!
The Feathers Fly Part II#145.dst: Esperemos acertar esta vez. ¡Tú guías, yo te sigo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#145.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#146.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#146.dst: ¡Ay, por favor, no me menciones la palabra «audiencia»!
The Feathers Fly Part II#146.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#147.src: I-I just got my invitation stolen! I can't believe this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#147.dst: ¡M-me acaban de robar la invitación! ¡No me lo puedo creer!
The Feathers Fly Part II#147.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#148.src: I asked around, obviously no one knows anything! I'm trying to look for it...
The Feathers Fly Part II#148.dst: He preguntado por ahí y nadie sabe nada, ¡claro! Sigo buscándola...
The Feathers Fly Part II#148.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#149.src: This inn has been under renovation for a while now... It's quite the spot to hide a stolen item!
The Feathers Fly Part II#149.dst: Esta posada lleva un tiempo en obras... ¡Menudo sitio para esconder algo robado!
The Feathers Fly Part II#149.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#150.src: But nooo, of course it's locked! Though it looks like we can access it from the back...
The Feathers Fly Part II#150.dst: ¡Pero nooo, claro, está cerrada! Aunque parece que se puede entrar por detrás...
The Feathers Fly Part II#150.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#151.src: It looks like there's some shady alleyway over there... Maybe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#151.dst: Parece que ahí hay un callejón oscuro... Quizá...
The Feathers Fly Part II#151.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#152.src: Ugh, sorry for ranting so much. I don't even know you. I'm sure there's a passage over there...
The Feathers Fly Part II#152.dst: Uf, perdona por quejarme tanto. Ni siquiera te conozco. Seguro que por ahí hay un pasadizo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#152.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#153.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're onto something but I'd rather not do anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around at the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#153.dst: Espera espera espera, seguro que algo has pillado, pero prefiero no hacer nada turbio en el pueblo. Haz lo que quieras, yo estaré por el centro.
The Feathers Fly Part II#153.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#154.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#154.dst: ¡Ay, por favor, no me menciones la palabra «audiencia»!
The Feathers Fly Part II#154.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#156.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#160.dst: Uf, perdona por quejarme tanto. Ni siquiera te conozco. Seguro que por ahí hay un pasadizo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#160.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#161.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're on to something but I'd rather not to anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around in the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#161.dst: Espera espera espera, seguro que algo has pillado, pero prefiero no hacer nada turbio en el pueblo. Haz lo que quieras, yo me quedo por el centro.
The Feathers Fly Part II#161.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#162.src: Let's hope we don't get rejected this time around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#162.dst: Esperemos que esta vez no nos echen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#162.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#163.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#163.dst: Así que el vendedor está ahí dentro, ¿eh? Sigamos adelante. Y evitemos ese sitio.
The Feathers Fly Part II#163.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#164.src: Oh god, not another duo. What do you want?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#164.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#165.src: Oh, uh, greetings! We have something for you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#165.dst: ¡Ah, eh, buenos días! ¡Tenemos algo para usted!
The Feathers Fly Part II#165.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#166.src: And what would a mechanic have for- Wait, is that an invitation letter..?
The Feathers Fly Part II#166.dst: ¿Y qué va a tener una mecánica pa- Espera, ¿eso es una invitación?
The Feathers Fly Part II#166.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#167.src: That's... Unprecedented. Let me check when the council's available and book an audience...
The Feathers Fly Part II#167.dst: Esto es... inaudito. Voy a ver cuándo tiene hueco el Consejo y os reservo una audiencia...
The Feathers Fly Part II#167.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#168.src: You two are extremely lucky. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#168.dst: Tenéis muchísima suerte. Casi no me lo creo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#168.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#169.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#169.dst: Espero que mañana por la mañana os venga bien, porque el Consejo está libre justo a esa hora.
The Feathers Fly Part II#169.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#170.src: Sounds good? Hopefully it does, because you don't really have much of a choice. Well, you can leave now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.dst: ¿Os parece bien? Más os vale, porque tampoco tenéis mucha opción. Bueno, ya podéis iros.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#171.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.dst: ¡No me creo que estemos avanzando de verdad! ¡Qué emoción!
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#172.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.dst: Vale, hay que probar la máquina antes de la audiencia. ¡He hecho algunos ajustes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#173.src: Meet me near the northern entrance if ya want a lift. Alternatively, you can just go by the Workshop if you're into walking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#173.dst: Nos vemos cerca de la entrada norte si quieres que te lleve. O si prefieres andar, ¡vete directo al Taller!
The Feathers Fly Part II#173.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#175.src: So, how do I find help...
The Feathers Fly Part II#175.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#176.src: I sure do love... Money. Totally!
The Feathers Fly Part II#176.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#178.src: Alright, so it's not really on the legal side of things, BUT apparently...
The Feathers Fly Part II#178.dst: Vale, no es que sea muy legal, PERO por lo visto...
The Feathers Fly Part II#178.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#179.src: There's some sort of... Shady dealer you can buy an audience invitation from?
The Feathers Fly Part II#179.dst: Hay una especie de... traficante turbio que te vende una invitación, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#179.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#180.src: I'm sure there are other ways, but the dude should be in the castle to the east, first door to the left.
The Feathers Fly Part II#180.dst: Seguro que hay otras formas, pero el tipo debería estar en el castillo del este, primera puerta a la izquierda.
The Feathers Fly Part II#180.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#181.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#181.dst: Haz lo que quieras con eso. Yo supongo que... seguiré buscando.
The Feathers Fly Part II#181.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#182.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#182.dst: ¿Una audiencia? Ah, eres de esos, ya veo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#182.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#183.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#183.dst: Sí, sí, cruza ese castillo de ahí y llegarás a la recepcionista.
The Feathers Fly Part II#183.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#184.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#184.dst: Las posibilidades de conseguirla son mínimas. Tendrías más suerte robándole la invitación a alguien, ¡je!
The Feathers Fly Part II#184.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#185.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#185.dst: Y hablando de eso... creo que justo pasó hace una hora al otro lado del pueblo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#185.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#186.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#186.dst: A lo mejor puedes ayudar a quien perdió su invitación. O robarla. ¡Yo no soy tu jefe! ¡Y ahora, largo! ¡No pises mis plantas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#186.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#188.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#188.dst: O sea, sí, cualquiera puede intentarlo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#188.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#189.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#189.dst: Pero hay que ser impresionante de verdad. No quiero ser borde, pero no vas a dar la talla.
The Feathers Fly Part II#189.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#190.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#190.dst: Si de verdad quieres, la recepcionista está en el castillo. Ve al este y no pares.
The Feathers Fly Part II#190.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#191.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#191.dst: Eso sí, te aviso: con la de locos que entran, nunca está de buen humor.
The Feathers Fly Part II#191.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#192.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#192.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#193.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#193.dst: Uf... Déjame adivinar qué es tu máquina. ¿Un arma? ¿Qué dispara? ¿Arena?
The Feathers Fly Part II#193.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#194.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#194.dst: Perdona, es que cansa un poco. Si de verdad quieres una audiencia, hay una recepcionista para eso.
The Feathers Fly Part II#194.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#195.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#195.dst: Pregunta a otros. Yo no llevo ese tipo de cosas.
The Feathers Fly Part II#195.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#196.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#196.dst: ¡¿Ah, tú también quieres conseguir una audiencia?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#196.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#197.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#197.dst: ¡Llevo forjando las mejores espadas robotizadas que verá el mundo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#197.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#198.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#198.dst: ¡Mira, tienes que ir a ver a la recepcionista y dejarla flipando!
The Feathers Fly Part II#198.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#199.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#199.dst: ¡Es genial! En el peor caso mueres, ¡pero con suerte solo te rompes un brazo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#199.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#200.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#200.dst: ¡Está dentro del castillo del este! Cruza y sigue andando, ¡al final llegas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#200.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#201.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#201.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#202.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#202.dst: Mmm... Así que podemos ir a ver a una recepcionista y quizá nos conceda una audiencia. ¡Entendido!
The Feathers Fly Part II#202.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#203.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#203.dst: Entramos, le enseñamos lo molones que somos y con eso bastará, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#203.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#204.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#204.dst: No pasa nada, seguro que solo hay que demostrarle tu determinación o algo así.
The Feathers Fly Part II#204.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#205.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#205.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#206.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#206.dst: ¡Por lo visto hay un tipo turbio que vende invitaciones a audiencias!
The Feathers Fly Part II#206.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#207.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#207.dst: Creo que está en el castillo del este, ¿primera a la izquierda? Aunque...
The Feathers Fly Part II#207.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#208.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#208.dst: Seguro que hay otras formas de lograrlo. ¡La recepcionista, por ejemplo! Está en la última sala del castillo, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#208.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#209.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#209.dst: De hecho, ¡si quieres que te acompañe, puedo! ¡Solo dímelo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#209.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#211.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#211.dst: Eh, chaval. Una audiencia, ¿eh? Je je je... Se me ocurre algo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#211.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#212.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#212.dst: ¿Sabes? Es difícil conseguir una... Muuuuy difícil... Pero sé cómo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#212.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#213.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#213.dst: Es muy, muy sencillo... ¡Solo tienes que darme [{~} bloques de esmeralda] y yo me encargo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#213.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#214.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#214.dst: ...je je je... ¡Bueno, ya sabes dónde encontrarme si te animas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#214.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#215.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#215.dst: ¿Así que has encontrado a ese vendedor raro? No estarás pensando en...
The Feathers Fly Part II#215.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#216.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#216.dst: O sea... la verdad es que sí sería una forma de conseguir una audiencia. ¿Qué quiere?
The Feathers Fly Part II#216.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#217.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#217.dst: ¿[{~} bloques de esmeralda]? ¿Es mucho? ¡No soy humana! ¡En fin!
The Feathers Fly Part II#217.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#218.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#218.dst: Cómpralo si quieres, pero estoy segura de que hay otras formas de conseguir una audiencia. No hace falta que lo compres.
The Feathers Fly Part II#218.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#219.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#219.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#220.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#220.dst: ¡Muchas gracias! Un placer hacer negocios contigo, je je... ¡Suerte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#220.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#222.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#222.dst: ¡¿Pero qué os pasa a todos?! ¡¿No puedo estar tranquila CINCO MINUTOS?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#222.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#223.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#223.dst: Ay, perdoooona, ¿te ha dicho alguien que vengas? ¿Vas a «impresionarme»?
The Feathers Fly Part II#223.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#224.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#224.dst: Pues te lo digo ya: has FALLADO.
The Feathers Fly Part II#224.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#225.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#225.dst: Vuelve cuando tengas algo de interés de verdad. Adiós.
The Feathers Fly Part II#225.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#226.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#226.dst: ¿Ah? ¿Has encontrado al vendedor y otra forma de conseguir audiencia?
The Feathers Fly Part II#226.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#227.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#227.dst: ¿[{~} bloques de esmeralda], eh? Ni idea de si es mucho. ¡Yo digo que probemos tu otra opción! ¿Cuál es?
The Feathers Fly Part II#227.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#228.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#228.dst: ¿Hay una recepcionista para las audiencias? ¡Qué cómodo! ¡Pues vamos a hablar con ella!
The Feathers Fly Part II#228.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#229.src: It's difficult to get an audience? Well, it's worth a try, right? Maybe they'll see me as a wealthy lad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.dst: ¿Es difícil conseguir una audiencia? Bueno, vale la pena intentarlo, ¿no? ¡Quizá me vean como una ricachona!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#230.src: Buy from that weird dealer if ya want, but we also should try to go see that receptionist. Tell me if you want me to follow you there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#230.dst: Cómprale a ese vendedor raro si quieres, pero también deberíamos ir a ver a la recepcionista. Dime si quieres que te acompañe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#230.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#231.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#231.dst: Vale, pues vamos. Yo diría que evitemos al vendedor, ¡no quiero problemas con la ley!
The Feathers Fly Part II#231.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#232.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#232.dst: Así que el vendedor está ahí dentro, ¿eh? Sigamos adelante. Y evitemos ese sitio.
The Feathers Fly Part II#232.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#233.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#233.dst: Espera espera espera qué acabo de dec- Me haré pequeñita...
The Feathers Fly Part II#233.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#234.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#234.dst: ¡Eh, son [{~} bloques de esmeralda] o nada! ¡Tranquilo, os consigo audiencia a los dos! ¡Tu chica es tímida, ya veo! ¡Créeme, te entiendo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#234.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#235.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#235.dst: ¡Muchas gracias! Un placer hacer negocios contigo, je je... ¡Suerte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#235.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#238.src: Why hello there! Greetings! Welcome! You are looking splendid, dear!
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#239.src: Oh?! T-thank you... That's the first time someone told me such a thing!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.dst: ¿¡Eh!? G-gracias... ¡Es la primera vez que alguien me dice algo así!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#240.src: Don't be silly dear, you're beautiful! Say, you're looking to be an investor, am I right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.dst: ¡No diga tonterías, querida, es usted preciosa! Dígame, busca invertir, ¿verdad?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#241.src: ...Will that grant me an audience with the Council?
The Feathers Fly Part II#241.dst: ...¿Eso me conseguirá una audiencia con el Consejo?
The Feathers Fly Part II#241.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#242.src: Why of course! Is that other person your assistant? Great!
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.dst: ¡Pues claro! ¿Esa otra persona es su ayudante? ¡Estupendo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#243.src: I'd like you to show me you have what it takes to be a great investor, yes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.dst: ¡Quiero que me demuestre que tiene madera de gran inversora, sí!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#244.src: Just hand over a mere [{~} Liquified Emeralds] and it's settled!
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.dst: ¡Solo tiene que darme [{~} esmeraldas líquidas] y asunto resuelto!
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#245.src: I- We'll... see what we can do.
The Feathers Fly Part II#245.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#246.src: Look, I'm not good at being a human but even I know this is an absurd amount of money!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.dst: Mira, no se me da bien ser humana, ¡pero hasta yo sé que eso es una barbaridad de dinero!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#247.src: Do you think she'd actually take it? I'm not sure. We might have to find another way...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.dst: ¿Tú crees que lo aceptaría de verdad? No sé. Igual tenemos que buscar otra forma...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#248.src: I'll go back to the town center. It's up to you if you want to risk all that money, if you even have it! We'll figure something else out.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.dst: Yo vuelvo al centro del pueblo. Tú decides si quieres arriesgar todo ese dinero, ¡si es que lo tienes! Ya se nos ocurrirá otra cosa.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#249.src: Oh, you're back! With the money I see! Surprising! I like you two!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.dst: ¡Ah, han vuelto! ¡Y con el dinero! ¡Qué sorpresa! ¡Me caen bien!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#250.src: What? Of course I'm not taking the money! I just wanted to know if you had what it takes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.dst: ¿Qué? ¡Claro que no voy a aceptar el dinero! ¡Solo quería saber si tenía lo que hay que tener!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#251.src: Now I'm sure you're not a scam. Let me see when the council's available...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.dst: Ahora sé que no son un timo. Voy a ver cuándo tiene hueco el Consejo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#252.src: Thanks! I'll try not to disappoint you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#252.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#253.src: You are two lucky people! We do have a free spot!
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#254.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you! We'll see you there then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.dst: ¡Espero que mañana por la mañana les venga bien! ¡Nos vemos allí!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#256.src: That's crazy! [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? Is that how the world works?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.dst: ¡Es una locura! ¿[{~} esmeraldas líquidas]? ¿Así funciona el mundo?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#257.src: It's just... I honestly don't care about listening to the law anymore.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.dst: Es que... sinceramente, ya me da igual respetar la ley.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#258.src: Let's just get that audience. For one, there's some girl panicking by the Armour Merchant! Maybe she could help?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.dst: Vamos a por esa audiencia. ¡Hay una chica agobiada junto al mercader de armaduras! ¿Y si nos ayuda?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#259.src: As for another way, I don't know if you paid attention on our way to the receptionist, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.dst: Y otra opción: no sé si te fijaste de camino a la recepcionista, pero...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#260.src: There is apparently a dealer in there. He does charge money too, though. But surely not as much as that... wretched... lady! ...Sorry.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.dst: Por lo visto ahí dentro hay un vendedor. Él también cobra, claro. ¡Pero seguro que no tanto como esa... maldita... señora! ...Perdón.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#261.src: I'm sure we can find a free alternative. I'm counting on ya! Just tell me if you want me to follow you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#261.dst: Seguro que encontramos una alternativa gratis. ¡Cuento contigo! ¡Dime si quieres que te acompañe!
The Feathers Fly Part II#261.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#262.src: Let's hope we get this right. You lead, I follow!
The Feathers Fly Part II#262.dst: Esperemos acertar esta vez. ¡Tú guías, yo te sigo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#262.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#263.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#263.dst: ¡Ay, por favor, no me menciones la palabra «audiencia»!
The Feathers Fly Part II#263.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#264.src: I-I just got my invitation stolen! I can't believe this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#264.dst: ¡M-me acaban de robar la invitación! ¡No me lo puedo creer!
The Feathers Fly Part II#264.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#265.src: I asked around, obviously no one knows anything! I'm trying to look for it...
The Feathers Fly Part II#265.dst: He preguntado por ahí y nadie sabe nada, ¡claro! Sigo buscándola...
The Feathers Fly Part II#265.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#266.src: This inn has been under renovation for a while now... It's quite the spot to hide a stolen item!
The Feathers Fly Part II#266.dst: Esta posada lleva un tiempo en obras... ¡Menudo sitio para esconder algo robado!
The Feathers Fly Part II#266.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#267.src: But nooo, of course it's locked! Though it looks like we can access it from the back...
The Feathers Fly Part II#267.dst: ¡Pero nooo, claro, está cerrada! Aunque parece que se puede entrar por detrás...
The Feathers Fly Part II#267.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#268.src: It looks like there's some shady alleyway over there... Maybe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#268.dst: Parece que ahí hay un callejón oscuro... Quizá...
The Feathers Fly Part II#268.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#269.src: Ugh, sorry for ranting so much. I don't even know you. I'm sure there's a passage over there...
The Feathers Fly Part II#269.dst: Uf, perdona por quejarme tanto. Ni siquiera te conozco. Seguro que por ahí hay un pasadizo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#269.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#270.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're onto something but I'd rather not do anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around at the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#270.dst: Espera espera espera, seguro que algo has pillado, pero prefiero no hacer nada turbio en el pueblo. Haz lo que quieras, yo estaré por el centro.
The Feathers Fly Part II#270.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#271.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#271.dst: ¡Ay, por favor, no me menciones la palabra «audiencia»!
The Feathers Fly Part II#271.speaker: Corkus Citizen
