The Feathers Fly Part II#277.dst: Uf, perdona por quejarme tanto. Ni siquiera te conozco. Seguro que por ahí hay un pasadizo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#277.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#278.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're on to something but I'd rather not to anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around in the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#278.dst: Espera espera espera, seguro que algo has pillado, pero prefiero no hacer nada turbio en el pueblo. Haz lo que quieras, yo me quedo por el centro.
The Feathers Fly Part II#278.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#279.src: Let's hope we get this right. You lead, I follow!
The Feathers Fly Part II#279.dst: Esperemos acertar esta vez. ¡Tú guías, yo te sigo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#279.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#280.src: Oh! Why hello there you two! How may I be of assistance?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.dst: ¡Oh! ¡Buenos días, ustedes dos! ¿En qué puedo ayudarles?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#281.src: Oh, uh, greetings! We have something for you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#281.dst: ¡Ah, eh, buenos días! ¡Tenemos algo para usted!
The Feathers Fly Part II#281.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#282.src: You're looking splendid dear! Now, are you-- Wait, you have a letter?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.dst: ¡Está espléndida, querida! Y bien, ¿viene a- Espere, ¿tiene una carta?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#283.src: That's... Unprecedented. Let me check when the council's available and book an audience...
The Feathers Fly Part II#283.dst: Esto es... inaudito. Voy a ver cuándo tiene hueco el Consejo y os reservo una audiencia...
The Feathers Fly Part II#283.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#284.src: You two are extremely lucky. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#284.dst: Tenéis muchísima suerte. Casi no me lo creo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#284.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#285.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#285.dst: Espero que mañana por la mañana os venga bien, porque el Consejo está libre justo a esa hora.
The Feathers Fly Part II#285.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#286.src: You know miss, you look like you could've been a great investor. Oh well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.dst: ¿Sabe, señorita? Parece que habría sido una gran inversora. En fin, ¡buena suerte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#287.src: If you want a tip, well... There's a new guy in the Council, so he might be easier to impress!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.dst: Si quiere un consejo, pues... Hay uno nuevo en el Consejo, ¡quizá sea más fácil de impresionar!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#288.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#288.dst: ¡No me creo que estemos avanzando de verdad! ¡Qué emoción!
The Feathers Fly Part II#288.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#289.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#289.dst: Vale, hay que probar la máquina antes de la audiencia. ¡He hecho algunos ajustes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#289.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#290.src: Meet me near the northern entrance if ya want a lift. Alternatively, you can just go by the Workshop if you're into walking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#290.dst: Nos vemos cerca de la entrada norte si quieres que te lleve. O si prefieres andar, ¡vete directo al Taller!
The Feathers Fly Part II#290.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#295.src: Alright, so it's not really on the legal side of things, BUT apparently...
The Feathers Fly Part II#295.dst: Vale, no es que sea muy legal, PERO por lo visto...
The Feathers Fly Part II#295.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#296.src: There's some sort of... Shady dealer you can buy an audience invitation from?
The Feathers Fly Part II#296.dst: Hay una especie de... traficante turbio que te vende una invitación, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#296.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#297.src: I'm sure there are other ways, but the dude should be in the castle to the east, first door to the left.
The Feathers Fly Part II#297.dst: Seguro que hay otras formas, pero el tipo debería estar en el castillo del este, primera puerta a la izquierda.
The Feathers Fly Part II#297.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#298.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#298.dst: Haz lo que quieras con eso. Yo supongo que... seguiré buscando.
The Feathers Fly Part II#298.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#299.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#299.dst: ¿Una audiencia? Ah, eres de esos, ya veo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#299.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#300.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#300.dst: Sí, sí, cruza ese castillo de ahí y llegarás a la recepcionista.
The Feathers Fly Part II#300.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#301.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#301.dst: Las posibilidades de conseguirla son mínimas. Tendrías más suerte robándole la invitación a alguien, ¡je!
The Feathers Fly Part II#301.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#302.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#302.dst: Y hablando de eso... creo que justo pasó hace una hora al otro lado del pueblo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#302.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#303.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#303.dst: A lo mejor puedes ayudar a quien perdió su invitación. O robarla. ¡Yo no soy tu jefe! ¡Y ahora, largo! ¡No pises mis plantas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#303.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#305.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#305.dst: O sea, sí, cualquiera puede intentarlo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#305.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#306.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#306.dst: Pero hay que ser impresionante de verdad. No quiero ser borde, pero no vas a dar la talla.
The Feathers Fly Part II#306.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#307.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#307.dst: Si de verdad quieres, la recepcionista está en el castillo. Ve al este y no pares.
The Feathers Fly Part II#307.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#308.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#308.dst: Eso sí, te aviso: con la de locos que entran, nunca está de buen humor.
The Feathers Fly Part II#308.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#309.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#309.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#310.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#310.dst: Uf... Déjame adivinar qué es tu máquina. ¿Un arma? ¿Qué dispara? ¿Arena?
The Feathers Fly Part II#310.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#311.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#311.dst: Perdona, es que cansa un poco. Si de verdad quieres una audiencia, hay una recepcionista para eso.
The Feathers Fly Part II#311.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#312.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#312.dst: Pregunta a otros. Yo no llevo ese tipo de cosas.
The Feathers Fly Part II#312.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#313.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#313.dst: ¡¿Ah, tú también quieres conseguir una audiencia?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#313.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#314.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#314.dst: ¡Llevo forjando las mejores espadas robotizadas que verá el mundo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#314.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#315.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#315.dst: ¡Mira, tienes que ir a ver a la recepcionista y dejarla flipando!
The Feathers Fly Part II#315.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#316.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#316.dst: ¡Es genial! En el peor caso mueres, ¡pero con suerte solo te rompes un brazo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#316.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#317.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#317.dst: ¡Está dentro del castillo del este! Cruza y sigue andando, ¡al final llegas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#317.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#318.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#318.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#319.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#319.dst: Mmm... Así que podemos ir a ver a una recepcionista y quizá nos conceda una audiencia. ¡Entendido!
The Feathers Fly Part II#319.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#320.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#320.dst: Entramos, le enseñamos lo molones que somos y con eso bastará, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#320.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#321.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#321.dst: No pasa nada, seguro que solo hay que demostrarle tu determinación o algo así.
The Feathers Fly Part II#321.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#322.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#322.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#323.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#323.dst: ¡Por lo visto hay un tipo turbio que vende invitaciones a audiencias!
The Feathers Fly Part II#323.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#324.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#324.dst: Creo que está en el castillo del este, ¿primera a la izquierda? Aunque...
The Feathers Fly Part II#324.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#325.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#325.dst: Seguro que hay otras formas de lograrlo. ¡La recepcionista, por ejemplo! Está en la última sala del castillo, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#325.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#326.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#326.dst: De hecho, ¡si quieres que te acompañe, puedo! ¡Solo dímelo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#326.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#328.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#328.dst: Eh, chaval. Una audiencia, ¿eh? Je je je... Se me ocurre algo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#328.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#329.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#329.dst: ¿Sabes? Es difícil conseguir una... Muuuuy difícil... Pero sé cómo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#329.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#330.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#330.dst: Es muy, muy sencillo... ¡Solo tienes que darme [{~} bloques de esmeralda] y yo me encargo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#330.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#331.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#331.dst: ...je je je... ¡Bueno, ya sabes dónde encontrarme si te animas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#331.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#332.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#332.dst: ¿Así que has encontrado a ese vendedor raro? No estarás pensando en...
The Feathers Fly Part II#332.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#333.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#333.dst: O sea... la verdad es que sí sería una forma de conseguir una audiencia. ¿Qué quiere?
The Feathers Fly Part II#333.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#334.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#334.dst: ¿[{~} bloques de esmeralda]? ¿Es mucho? ¡No soy humana! ¡En fin!
The Feathers Fly Part II#334.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#335.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#335.dst: Cómpralo si quieres, pero estoy segura de que hay otras formas de conseguir una audiencia. No hace falta que lo compres.
The Feathers Fly Part II#335.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#336.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#336.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#337.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#337.dst: ¡Muchas gracias! Un placer hacer negocios contigo, je je... ¡Suerte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#337.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#339.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#339.dst: ¡¿Pero qué os pasa a todos?! ¡¿No puedo estar tranquila CINCO MINUTOS?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#339.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#340.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#340.dst: Ay, perdoooona, ¿te ha dicho alguien que vengas? ¿Vas a «impresionarme»?
The Feathers Fly Part II#340.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#341.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#341.dst: Pues te lo digo ya: has FALLADO.
The Feathers Fly Part II#341.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#342.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#342.dst: Vuelve cuando tengas algo de interés de verdad. Adiós.
The Feathers Fly Part II#342.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#343.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#343.dst: ¿Ah? ¿Has encontrado al vendedor y otra forma de conseguir audiencia?
The Feathers Fly Part II#343.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#344.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#344.dst: ¿[{~} bloques de esmeralda], eh? Ni idea de si es mucho. ¡Yo digo que probemos tu otra opción! ¿Cuál es?
The Feathers Fly Part II#344.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#345.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#345.dst: ¿Hay una recepcionista para las audiencias? ¡Qué cómodo! ¡Pues vamos a hablar con ella!
The Feathers Fly Part II#345.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#346.src: It's... Apparently really hard? Huh. Well, we should still give it a go? I look fancy, surely they'll listen!
The Feathers Fly Part II#346.dst: Y... ¿parece que es muy difícil? Vaya. ¿Lo intentamos igual? ¡Voy elegante, seguro que me escuchan!
The Feathers Fly Part II#346.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#347.src: Buy from that weird dealer if ya want, but we also should try to go see that receptionist. Tell me if you want me to follow you there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#347.dst: Cómprale a ese vendedor raro si quieres, pero también deberíamos ir a ver a la recepcionista. Dime si quieres que te acompañe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#347.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#348.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#348.dst: Vale, pues vamos. Yo diría que evitemos al vendedor, ¡no quiero problemas con la ley!
The Feathers Fly Part II#348.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#349.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#349.dst: Así que el vendedor está ahí dentro, ¿eh? Sigamos adelante. Y evitemos ese sitio.
The Feathers Fly Part II#349.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#350.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#350.dst: Espera espera espera qué acabo de dec- Me haré pequeñita...
The Feathers Fly Part II#350.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#351.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#351.dst: ¡Eh, son [{~} bloques de esmeralda] o nada! ¡Tranquilo, os consigo audiencia a los dos! ¡Tu chica es tímida, ya veo! ¡Créeme, te entiendo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#351.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#352.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#352.dst: ¡Muchas gracias! Un placer hacer negocios contigo, je je... ¡Suerte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#352.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#355.src: And just WHO are you two, busting here like that?
The Feathers Fly Part II#355.dst: ¿Y QUIÉNES sois vosotros dos para entrar así?
The Feathers Fly Part II#355.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#356.src: Uh... Greetings... We've heard that we should come here for-
The Feathers Fly Part II#356.dst: Eh... Buenos días... Nos han dicho que viniéramos aquí para-
The Feathers Fly Part II#356.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#357.src: Do you have ANYTHING to show? I need more than fancy clothes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#357.dst: ¿Tenéis ALGO que enseñar? Con ropa elegante no me basta.
The Feathers Fly Part II#357.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#358.src: Oh, uh, we, well I actually made a, uh, what's it called, uh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#358.dst: Ah, eh, nosotros, bueno, yo hice un, eh, ¿cómo se llama?, eh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#358.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#359.src: Not Another word! I've heard enough! You two clearly don't have anything worth my time!
The Feathers Fly Part II#359.dst: ¡Ni UNA palabra más! ¡Ya he oído bastante! ¡Está claro que no tenéis nada que merezca mi tiempo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#359.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#360.src: And what's up with your face, lady? I'd look into that if I were you! OUT!
The Feathers Fly Part II#360.dst: ¿Y qué le pasa a tu cara, señorita? ¡Yo que tú me lo miraba! ¡FUERA!
The Feathers Fly Part II#360.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#361.src: The citizens said it was hard, huh? No kidding. Maybe we should've had something before strolling in.
The Feathers Fly Part II#361.dst: Los vecinos decían que era difícil, ¿eh? Y tanto. Quizá deberíamos haber traído algo antes de entrar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#361.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#362.src: Look, we'll figure out another approach. This can't end here! We need an audience invitation letter.
The Feathers Fly Part II#362.dst: Mira, ya buscaremos otra forma. ¡Esto no acaba aquí! Necesitamos una carta de invitación a la audiencia.
The Feathers Fly Part II#362.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#363.src: I'll head back to the town center, so if you want to talk I'll see ya there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#363.dst: Yo vuelvo al centro del pueblo, ¡si quieres hablar nos vemos allí!
The Feathers Fly Part II#363.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#364.src: That certainly didn't go well. But keep your head up! We got this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#364.dst: Desde luego no ha ido bien. ¡Pero ánimo! ¡Podemos con esto!
The Feathers Fly Part II#364.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#365.src: There was a normal way to get an audience which is via a competition. We... missed it. So that'll have to pass.
The Feathers Fly Part II#365.dst: Había una forma normal de conseguir audiencia: un concurso. Nos lo... perdimos. Así que habrá que olvidarlo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#365.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#366.src: Now, for other... Unconventional ways... There was some panic by the Armour Merchant earlier today.
The Feathers Fly Part II#366.dst: Y en cuanto a otras formas... poco convencionales... Hoy ha habido jaleo junto al mercader de armaduras.
The Feathers Fly Part II#366.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#367.src: Maybe that's our ticket? I don't know, I'm just a law-abiding citizen. Well, actually, about that...
The Feathers Fly Part II#367.dst: ¿Y si ese es nuestro billete? No sé, yo solo soy una ciudadana honrada. Bueno, en realidad, sobre eso...
The Feathers Fly Part II#367.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#368.src: There is apparently a dealer in the castle the receptionist's in, first entrance to the left. However, he charges emeralds...
The Feathers Fly Part II#368.dst: Por lo visto hay un vendedor en el castillo de la recepcionista, primera entrada a la izquierda. Pero cobra esmeraldas...
The Feathers Fly Part II#368.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#369.src: I'm sure we can find a free alternative. I'm counting on ya! Just tell me if you want me to follow you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#369.dst: Seguro que encontramos una alternativa gratis. ¡Cuento contigo! ¡Dime si quieres que te acompañe!
The Feathers Fly Part II#369.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#370.src: Let's hope we don't get rejected this time around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#370.dst: Esperemos que esta vez no nos echen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#370.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#371.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#371.dst: ¡Ay, por favor, no me menciones la palabra «audiencia»!
The Feathers Fly Part II#371.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#372.src: I-I just got my invitation stolen! I can't believe this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#372.dst: ¡M-me acaban de robar la invitación! ¡No me lo puedo creer!
The Feathers Fly Part II#372.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#373.src: I asked around, obviously no one knows anything! I'm trying to look for it...
The Feathers Fly Part II#373.dst: He preguntado por ahí y nadie sabe nada, ¡claro! Sigo buscándola...
The Feathers Fly Part II#373.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#374.src: This inn has been under renovation for a while now... It's quite the spot to hide a stolen item!
The Feathers Fly Part II#374.dst: Esta posada lleva un tiempo en obras... ¡Menudo sitio para esconder algo robado!
The Feathers Fly Part II#374.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#375.src: But nooo, of course it's locked! Though it looks like we can access it from the back...
The Feathers Fly Part II#375.dst: ¡Pero nooo, claro, está cerrada! Aunque parece que se puede entrar por detrás...
The Feathers Fly Part II#375.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#376.src: It looks like there's some shady alleyway over there... Maybe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#376.dst: Parece que ahí hay un callejón oscuro... Quizá...
The Feathers Fly Part II#376.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#377.src: Ugh, sorry for ranting so much. I don't even know you. I'm sure there's a passage over there...
The Feathers Fly Part II#377.dst: Uf, perdona por quejarme tanto. Ni siquiera te conozco. Seguro que por ahí hay un pasadizo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#377.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#378.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're on to something but I'd rather not to anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around in the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#378.dst: Espera espera espera, seguro que algo has pillado, pero prefiero no hacer nada turbio en el pueblo. Haz lo que quieras, yo me quedo por el centro.
The Feathers Fly Part II#378.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#379.src: Leaving town? I'll stick around, just come back eventually, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#379.dst: ¿Te vas del pueblo? Yo me quedo por aquí, pero vuelve, ¿vale?
The Feathers Fly Part II#379.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#380.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#380.dst: ¡Ay, por favor, no me menciones la palabra «audiencia»!
The Feathers Fly Part II#380.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#386.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#387.dst: Esperemos que esta vez no nos echen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#387.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#388.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#388.dst: Así que el vendedor está ahí dentro, ¿eh? Sigamos adelante. Y evitemos ese sitio.
The Feathers Fly Part II#388.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#389.src: Oh god, not another duo. What do you want?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#389.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#390.src: Oh, uh, greetings! We have something for you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#390.dst: ¡Ah, eh, buenos días! ¡Tenemos algo para usted!
The Feathers Fly Part II#390.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#391.src: Why sure darling, you have {~} seconds to- Hold on, that letter...
The Feathers Fly Part II#391.dst: Claro que sí, cariño, tiene {~} segundos para- Un momento, esa carta...
The Feathers Fly Part II#391.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#392.src: That's... Unprecedented. Let me check when the council's available and book an audience...
The Feathers Fly Part II#392.dst: Esto es... inaudito. Voy a ver cuándo tiene hueco el Consejo y os reservo una audiencia...
The Feathers Fly Part II#392.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#393.src: You two are extremely luck. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#393.dst: Tenéis muchísima suerte. Casi no me lo creo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#393.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#394.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#394.dst: Espero que mañana por la mañana os venga bien, porque el Consejo está libre justo a esa hora.
The Feathers Fly Part II#394.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#395.src: Don't miss it. Oh, and miss, there's something really off about your face.
The Feathers Fly Part II#395.dst: No faltéis. Ah, y señorita, tu cara tiene algo muy raro.
The Feathers Fly Part II#395.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#396.src: Thank you so much! Sorry about my face, I'm... New in town. Bye!
The Feathers Fly Part II#396.dst: ¡Muchísimas gracias! Perdone mi cara, soy... nueva en el pueblo. ¡Adiós!
The Feathers Fly Part II#396.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#397.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#397.dst: ¡No me creo que estemos avanzando de verdad! ¡Qué emoción!
The Feathers Fly Part II#397.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#398.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#398.dst: Vale, hay que probar la máquina antes de la audiencia. ¡He hecho algunos ajustes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#398.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#399.src: Meet me near the northern entrance if ya want a lift. Alternatively, you can just go by the Workshop if you're into walking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#399.dst: Nos vemos cerca de la entrada norte si quieres que te lleve. O si prefieres andar, ¡vete directo al Taller!
The Feathers Fly Part II#399.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#400.src: Urgh, what now? You better be quick.
The Feathers Fly Part II#400.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#401.src: Wait you... You actually have an invitation letter? ...How...
The Feathers Fly Part II#401.dst: Espera, tú... ¿de verdad tienes una carta de invitación? ...Cómo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#401.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#402.src: Wait, WHY do you have TWO letters?? This doesn't make any sense?! Oh well, whatever I'm not paid enough to care.
The Feathers Fly Part II#402.dst: Espera, ¿POR QUÉ tienes DOS cartas?? ¡¿Esto no tiene ningún sentido?! En fin, da igual, no me pagan para preocuparme.
The Feathers Fly Part II#402.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#403.src: Oh, wow, you're not gonna believe this. You're a lucky one. Are you alone? No?
The Feathers Fly Part II#403.dst: Vaya, no te lo vas a creer. Qué suerte tienes. ¿Vas solo? ¿No?
The Feathers Fly Part II#403.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#404.src: Well, I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time
The Feathers Fly Part II#404.dst: Bueno, espero que mañana por la mañana te venga bien, porque el Consejo está libre justo a esa hora
The Feathers Fly Part II#404.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#405.src: Sounds good? Well. go tell your partner about this you are two lucky Corkians!
The Feathers Fly Part II#405.dst: ¿Bien? Pues ve a contárselo a tu socio, ¡sois dos corkianos con suerte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#405.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#407.src: Alright, so it's not really on the legal side of things, BUT apparently...
The Feathers Fly Part II#407.dst: Vale, no es que sea muy legal, PERO por lo visto...
The Feathers Fly Part II#407.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#408.src: There's some sort of... Shady dealer you can buy an audience invitation from?
The Feathers Fly Part II#408.dst: Hay una especie de... traficante turbio que te vende una invitación, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#408.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#409.src: I'm sure there are other ways, but the dude should be in the castle to the east, first door to the left.
The Feathers Fly Part II#409.dst: Seguro que hay otras formas, pero el tipo debería estar en el castillo del este, primera puerta a la izquierda.
The Feathers Fly Part II#409.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#410.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#410.dst: Haz lo que quieras con eso. Yo supongo que... seguiré buscando.
The Feathers Fly Part II#410.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#411.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#411.dst: ¿Una audiencia? Ah, eres de esos, ya veo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#411.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#412.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#412.dst: Sí, sí, cruza ese castillo de ahí y llegarás a la recepcionista.
The Feathers Fly Part II#412.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#413.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#413.dst: Las posibilidades de conseguirla son mínimas. Tendrías más suerte robándole la invitación a alguien, ¡je!
The Feathers Fly Part II#413.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#414.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#414.dst: Y hablando de eso... creo que justo pasó hace una hora al otro lado del pueblo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#414.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#415.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#415.dst: A lo mejor puedes ayudar a quien perdió su invitación. O robarla. ¡Yo no soy tu jefe! ¡Y ahora, largo! ¡No pises mis plantas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#415.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#417.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#417.dst: O sea, sí, cualquiera puede intentarlo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#417.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#418.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#418.dst: Pero hay que ser impresionante de verdad. No quiero ser borde, pero no vas a dar la talla.
The Feathers Fly Part II#418.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#419.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#419.dst: Si de verdad quieres, la recepcionista está en el castillo. Ve al este y no pares.
The Feathers Fly Part II#419.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#420.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#420.dst: Eso sí, te aviso: con la de locos que entran, nunca está de buen humor.
The Feathers Fly Part II#420.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#421.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#421.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#422.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#422.dst: Uf... Déjame adivinar qué es tu máquina. ¿Un arma? ¿Qué dispara? ¿Arena?
The Feathers Fly Part II#422.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#423.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#423.dst: Perdona, es que cansa un poco. Si de verdad quieres una audiencia, hay una recepcionista para eso.
The Feathers Fly Part II#423.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#424.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#424.dst: Pregunta a otros. Yo no llevo ese tipo de cosas.
The Feathers Fly Part II#424.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#425.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#425.dst: ¡¿Ah, tú también quieres conseguir una audiencia?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#425.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#426.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#426.dst: ¡Llevo forjando las mejores espadas robotizadas que verá el mundo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#426.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#427.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#427.dst: ¡Mira, tienes que ir a ver a la recepcionista y dejarla flipando!
The Feathers Fly Part II#427.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#428.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#428.dst: ¡Es genial! En el peor caso mueres, ¡pero con suerte solo te rompes un brazo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#428.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#429.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#429.dst: ¡Está dentro del castillo del este! Cruza y sigue andando, ¡al final llegas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#429.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#430.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#430.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#431.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#431.dst: Mmm... Así que podemos ir a ver a una recepcionista y quizá nos conceda una audiencia. ¡Entendido!
The Feathers Fly Part II#431.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#432.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#432.dst: Entramos, le enseñamos lo molones que somos y con eso bastará, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#432.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#433.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#433.dst: No pasa nada, seguro que solo hay que demostrarle tu determinación o algo así.
The Feathers Fly Part II#433.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#434.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#434.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#435.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#435.dst: ¡Por lo visto hay un tipo turbio que vende invitaciones a audiencias!
The Feathers Fly Part II#435.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#436.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#436.dst: Creo que está en el castillo del este, ¿primera a la izquierda? Aunque...
The Feathers Fly Part II#436.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#437.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#437.dst: Seguro que hay otras formas de lograrlo. ¡La recepcionista, por ejemplo! Está en la última sala del castillo, ¿no?
The Feathers Fly Part II#437.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#438.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#438.dst: De hecho, ¡si quieres que te acompañe, puedo! ¡Solo dímelo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#438.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#440.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#440.dst: Eh, chaval. Una audiencia, ¿eh? Je je je... Se me ocurre algo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#440.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#441.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#441.dst: ¿Sabes? Es difícil conseguir una... Muuuuy difícil... Pero sé cómo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#441.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#442.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#442.dst: Es muy, muy sencillo... ¡Solo tienes que darme [{~} bloques de esmeralda] y yo me encargo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#442.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#443.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#443.dst: ...je je je... ¡Bueno, ya sabes dónde encontrarme si te animas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#443.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#444.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#444.dst: ¿Así que has encontrado a ese vendedor raro? No estarás pensando en...
The Feathers Fly Part II#444.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#445.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#445.dst: O sea... la verdad es que sí sería una forma de conseguir una audiencia. ¿Qué quiere?
The Feathers Fly Part II#445.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#446.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#446.dst: ¿[{~} bloques de esmeralda]? ¿Es mucho? ¡No soy humana! ¡En fin!
The Feathers Fly Part II#446.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#447.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#447.dst: Cómpralo si quieres, pero estoy segura de que hay otras formas de conseguir una audiencia. No hace falta que lo compres.
The Feathers Fly Part II#447.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#448.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#448.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#449.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#449.dst: ¡Muchas gracias! Un placer hacer negocios contigo, je je... ¡Suerte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#449.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#451.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#451.dst: ¡¿Pero qué os pasa a todos?! ¡¿No puedo estar tranquila CINCO MINUTOS?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#451.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#452.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#452.dst: Ay, perdoooona, ¿te ha dicho alguien que vengas? ¿Vas a «impresionarme»?
The Feathers Fly Part II#452.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#453.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#453.dst: Pues te lo digo ya: has FALLADO.
The Feathers Fly Part II#453.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#454.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#454.dst: Vuelve cuando tengas algo de interés de verdad. Adiós.
The Feathers Fly Part II#454.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#455.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#455.dst: ¿Ah? ¿Has encontrado al vendedor y otra forma de conseguir audiencia?
The Feathers Fly Part II#455.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#456.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#456.dst: ¿[{~} bloques de esmeralda], eh? Ni idea de si es mucho. ¡Yo digo que probemos tu otra opción! ¿Cuál es?
The Feathers Fly Part II#456.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#457.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#457.dst: ¿Hay una recepcionista para las audiencias? ¡Qué cómodo! ¡Pues vamos a hablar con ella!
The Feathers Fly Part II#457.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#458.src: It's... Apparently really hard? Oh... Well, that's not helpful. Maybe we can still give it a go?
The Feathers Fly Part II#458.dst: Y... ¿parece que es muy difícil? Oh... Pues eso no ayuda. ¿Podemos intentarlo igualmente?
The Feathers Fly Part II#458.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#459.src: Buy from that weird dealer if ya want, but we also should try to go see that receptionist. Tell me if you want me to follow you there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#459.dst: Cómprale a ese vendedor raro si quieres, pero también deberíamos ir a ver a la recepcionista. Dime si quieres que te acompañe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#459.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#460.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#460.dst: Vale, pues vamos. Yo diría que evitemos al vendedor, ¡no quiero problemas con la ley!
The Feathers Fly Part II#460.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#461.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#461.dst: Así que el vendedor está ahí dentro, ¿eh? Sigamos adelante. Y evitemos ese sitio.
The Feathers Fly Part II#461.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#462.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#462.dst: Espera espera espera qué acabo de dec- Me haré pequeñita...
The Feathers Fly Part II#462.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#463.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#463.dst: ¡Eh, son [{~} bloques de esmeralda] o nada! ¡Tranquilo, os consigo audiencia a los dos! ¡Tu chica es tímida, ya veo! ¡Créeme, te entiendo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#463.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#464.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#464.dst: ¡Muchas gracias! Un placer hacer negocios contigo, je je... ¡Suerte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#464.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#467.src: Wow. I cannot stop staring at you... Such magnificent armour.
The Feathers Fly Part II#467.dst: Vaya. No puedo dejar de mirarte... Qué armadura tan magnífica.
The Feathers Fly Part II#467.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#468.src: Well sir, or miss, if you tried to impress me, you certainly succeeded.
The Feathers Fly Part II#468.dst: Pues señor, o señorita, si quería impresionarme, desde luego lo ha logrado.
The Feathers Fly Part II#468.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#469.src: Why thank you! I reckon you will search for an available time regarding an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#469.dst: ¡Pues gracias! ¿Supongo que buscará un hueco libre para una audiencia?
The Feathers Fly Part II#469.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#470.src: Well, you two seem very lucky, there's an available slot soon!
The Feathers Fly Part II#470.dst: ¡Pues parece que tienen mucha suerte, hay un hueco libre pronto!
The Feathers Fly Part II#470.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#471.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#471.dst: Espero que mañana por la mañana les venga bien, porque el Consejo está libre a esa hora.
The Feathers Fly Part II#471.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#472.dst: ¿Les parece bien? Se lo merecen, ust
The Feathers Fly Part II#472.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#473.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#473.dst: ¡Ay, por favor, no me menciones la palabra «audiencia»!
The Feathers Fly Part II#473.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#474.src: I-I just got my invitation stolen! I can't believe this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#474.dst: ¡M-me acaban de robar la invitación! ¡No me lo puedo creer!
The Feathers Fly Part II#474.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#475.src: I asked around, obviously no one knows anything! I'm trying to look for it...
The Feathers Fly Part II#475.dst: He preguntado por ahí y nadie sabe nada, ¡claro! Sigo buscándola...
The Feathers Fly Part II#475.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#476.src: This inn has been under renovation for a while now... It's quite the spot to hide a stolen item!
The Feathers Fly Part II#476.dst: Esta posada lleva un tiempo en obras... ¡Menudo sitio para esconder algo robado!
The Feathers Fly Part II#476.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#477.src: But nooo, of course it's locked! Though it looks like we can access it from the back...
The Feathers Fly Part II#477.dst: ¡Pero nooo, claro, está cerrada! Aunque parece que se puede entrar por detrás...
The Feathers Fly Part II#477.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#478.src: It looks like there's some shady alleyway over there... Maybe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#478.dst: Parece que ahí hay un callejón oscuro... Quizá...
The Feathers Fly Part II#478.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#479.src: Ugh, sorry for ranting so much. I don't even know you. I'm sure there's a passage over there...
The Feathers Fly Part II#479.dst: Uf, perdona por quejarme tanto. Ni siquiera te conozco. Seguro que por ahí hay un pasadizo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#479.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#480.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're on to something but I'd rather not to anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around in the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#480.dst: Espera espera espera, seguro que algo has pillado, pero prefiero no hacer nada turbio en el pueblo. Haz lo que quieras, yo me quedo por el centro.
The Feathers Fly Part II#480.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#481.src: Let's hope we don't get rejected this time around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#481.dst: Esperemos que esta vez no nos echen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#481.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#482.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#482.dst: Así que el vendedor está ahí dentro, ¿eh? Sigamos adelante. Y evitemos ese sitio.
The Feathers Fly Part II#482.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#483.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#483.dst: ¡No me creo que estemos avanzando de verdad! ¡Qué emoción!
The Feathers Fly Part II#483.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#484.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#484.dst: Vale, hay que probar la máquina antes de la audiencia. ¡He hecho algunos ajustes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#484.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#485.src: Meet me near the northern entrance if ya want a lift. Alternatively, you can just go by the Workshop if you're into walking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#485.dst: Nos vemos cerca de la entrada norte si quieres que te lleve. O si prefieres andar, ¡vete directo al Taller!
The Feathers Fly Part II#485.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#486.src: Help Ava operate the machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#486.dst: Ayuda a Ava a manejar la máquina en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#487.src: Hey! I'm back in my original clothes. It feels so much better...
The Feathers Fly Part II#487.dst: ¡Eh! Ya llevo mi ropa de siempre. Se está mucho mejor así...
The Feathers Fly Part II#487.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#488.src: Remember that hill next to the Workshop? We'll work there again. Tell me when you're ready for the lift.
The Feathers Fly Part II#488.dst: ¿Te acuerdas de la colina junto al Taller? Volvemos a trabajar allí. Dime cuando quieras que te lleve.
The Feathers Fly Part II#488.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#490.src: There we are! Talk to me and I'll tell you all about the changes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#490.dst: ¡Ya estamos! ¡Háblame y te cuento todos los cambios!
The Feathers Fly Part II#490.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#491.src: Do you remember how it worked last time? Don't worry, it's still fairly similar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#491.dst: ¿Recuerdas cómo iba la última vez? Tranquilo, es bastante parecido.
The Feathers Fly Part II#491.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#492.src: Once again, you'll have a remote. Simply click in the right orders. However!
The Feathers Fly Part II#492.dst: Otra vez tendrás un mando. Pulsa en el orden correcto. ¡Pero ojo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#492.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#493.src: Now, the machine requires a bit more... Dexterity.
The Feathers Fly Part II#493.dst: Ahora la máquina exige un poco más de... destreza.
The Feathers Fly Part II#493.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#494.src: If you're really quick, the machine will charge up real fast!
The Feathers Fly Part II#494.dst: ¡Si eres muy rápido, la máquina se cargará superrápido!
The Feathers Fly Part II#494.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#495.src: If you're too slow however, it'd take a bit of time to charge up...
The Feathers Fly Part II#495.dst: Pero si vas muy lento, tardará un rato en cargarse...
The Feathers Fly Part II#495.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#496.src: Time is still limited too. Don't worry, this is practice for the Council! Tell me once you're ready!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1251.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1252.src: First the Avos, then you, huh. So it's come full circle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1252.dst: Primero los Avos, ahora vosotros. Vaya, el círculo se cierra.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1252.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1253.src: Look, that machine of yours is impressive. I'm not lying. You're talented.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1253.dst: Mira, esa máquina tuya es impresionante. No miento. Tienes talento.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1253.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1254.src: But you've definitely made quite the mistake. I did too.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1254.dst: Pero desde luego has cometido un buen error. Yo también.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1254.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1255.src: I guess you and I really learnt what acting in the heat of the moment means, huh.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1255.dst: Supongo que tú y yo hemos aprendido de verdad lo que es actuar en caliente, ¿eh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1255.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1256.src: I have some sort of... Compromise. For us. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1256.dst: Tengo una especie de... acuerdo. Para las dos. ¿Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1256.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1257.src: Yeah, I'm... interested in working with you. Learning from you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1257.dst: Sí, me... interesa trabajar contigo. Aprender de ti.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1257.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1258.src: You're clearly better at Electromagic than I, so...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1258.dst: Está claro que se te da mejor la electromagia que a mí, así que...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1258.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1259.src: I'm willing to provide you with what you need. Help you out from time to time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1259.dst: Estoy dispuesto a darte lo que necesites. Echarte una mano de vez en cuando.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1259.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1260.src: You've been alone for so long, Ava. I'm lending you Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1260.dst: Has estado sola mucho tiempo, Ava. ¡Te presto a Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1260.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1261.src: Hey, don't say it like that!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1261.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1262.src: *chuckles* I'm kidding. The rest of the council isn't aware yet.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1262.dst: *se ríe* Es broma. El resto del Consejo aún no lo sabe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1262.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1263.src: They're not gonna like this, but I'll handle it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1263.dst: No les va a gustar, pero yo me encargo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1263.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1264.src: You know I can't kill you. Can you imagine how the Avos would take it? Even though you're banished...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1264.dst: Sabes que no puedo matarte. ¿Te imaginas cómo se lo tomarían los Avos? Aunque estés desterrada...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1264.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1265.src: But I don't want to either. As for you, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1265.dst: Pero tampoco quiero. Y en cuanto a ti, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1265.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1266.src: I'll give you some stuff. I can't imagine how things would've gone if it weren't for you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1266.dst: Te voy a dar unas cosas. No me imagino cómo habría acabado esto de no ser por ti.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1266.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1267.src: Now, you're banished from everyone Ava. I know that's no happy ending.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1267.dst: Bueno, Ava, quedas desterrada de todo. Sé que no es un final feliz.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1267.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1268.src: But that would've been too easy, don't ya think?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1268.dst: Pero eso habría sido demasiado fácil, ¿no crees?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1268.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1269.src: Maybe later, you'll get your happy ending. But you can settle with not being alone anymore, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1269.dst: Quizá más adelante tengas tu final feliz. Pero de momento te vale con no estar sola, ¿verdad?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1269.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, I might stop by sometimes. Maybe you'll have figured out that armour of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.dst: Adiós, Ava. Quién sabe, igual me paso de vez en cuando. Quizá para entonces hayas entendido esa armadura tuya.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1271.src: ...? If you stop by the Workshop later, maybe I'll have some things for you as well.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1271.dst: ...? Si te pasas luego por el Taller, quizá tenga algunas cosas para ti también.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1271.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.src: Please contact Cerid for more information about this model.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.dst: Para más información sobre este modelo, contacte con Cerid.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.src: If you have any questions, know that I am definitely not the right machine to ask.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.dst: Si tiene alguna pregunta, sepa que no soy en absoluto la máquina adecuada para responderla.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.src: Hey, it's alright. We'll be fine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.src: You know, that Workshop of yours is way nicer than I expected.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.dst: ¿Sabes? Ese Taller tuyo es mucho mejor de lo que esperaba.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.src: {u}, thanks for the help. You've introduced me to quite the talent!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.dst: {u}, gracias por la ayuda. ¡Me has presentado a todo un talento!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.src: Believe me, I know how rejection feels like. I guess everyone does, in their own ways.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.dst: Créeme, sé lo que es el rechazo. Supongo que todos lo sabemos, cada uno a su manera.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.src: Efena... She's nicer than Chief, that's for sure...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.dst: Efena... Desde luego es más maja que el jefe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.src: This is all... Very hard to believe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.dst: Todo esto es... muy difícil de creer.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.src: {u}, once you come back here, you'll be able to get some of my gadgets.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.dst: {u}, cuando vuelvas por aquí, podrás llevarte algunos de mis cacharros.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.speaker: Ava
